_comment: Copy this to sync.config.json (or run: node tools/db-sync.mjs init) and edit it for THIS machine. sync.config.json is gitignored because each machine points at the others: on the PC you list the laptop, on the laptop you list the PC.

_fields.host: ssh target — the thing that makes `ssh you@laptop.local` work
_fields.path: where this repo is cloned on that machine
_fields.port: ssh port, omit or 22 for the default
_fields.identity: ssh private key, or null to let ssh decide
_fields.sshOptions: optional array of extra flags passed to both ssh and scp
